_doc: THE RELEASE POLICY. Readable, version-controlled, reviewable in a PR.
No human decides the verdict on stage and no model does either — this file does.
Thresholds are deliberately visible. Healenium ships a score-cap of 0.6 and hides it;
a threshold you cannot see is a threshold you cannot audit.
autoHeal is 0.85 rather than 0.90 on measured evidence: a complete relabel of a control
whose role, tag, id, class, container and neighbours all still match scores ~0.88,
because the accessible name genuinely changed by ~76%. 0.90 would refuse a heal that is
provably correct. Below 0.85 you are guessing.

roi.assumptionNote: 12 min/fix is an ASSUMPTION, shown next to any number derived from it. The touched-files ratio below needs no assumption at all.

rules.reason: A real product defect was found. The suite is not permitted to go green by adjusting the test.
A locator had two plausible candidates within the margin. Applying one would risk a permanently-green test asserting nothing, so it was escalated.
A test was still failing after healing was applied and re-run.
A NEW critical security finding appeared that was not in the accepted baseline.
Known critical security debt is still open. Tracked against the baseline, not blocking this release.
New critical accessibility violations were detected by axe-core.
An acceptance criterion has no covering test. Generated coverage must trace to a requirement or it is padding.
